Elements.Text: <color=#00000000>缩进</color>EasyDocument is a Unity UI document browsing plugin based on TMP. It uses a folder under StreamingAssets as the document shell, containing document.json and image assets, supporting multi-level titles, body text, images and image captions with adaptive layout.

Each document is a folder shell, whose name is the document name, located under the EasyDocumentData folder in StreamingAssets. The folder must contain a document.json data file, and image assets are referenced by relative paths.

document.json uses a format recognizable by JsonUtility: the root object contains DocumentName and an Elements list. The element Type supports six types: TITLE_1 to TITLE_4, BODY and IMAGE. The IMAGE type records the image relative path via ImagePath and the image caption via Caption.

Create a style configuration asset via Create SO/EasyDocument/EasyDocumentSetting. You can drag an SDF font and preset color, font size, font style and alignment for each title level, body text and image caption. They take effect at runtime.
Drag an SDF font (TMP_FontAsset) into the FontAsset field of EasyDocumentSetting, and all text will be displayed with this font at runtime; leave it empty to fall back to the TMP default font.

Attach the EasyDocumentController script to any RectTransform object under a Canvas, configure the style asset and document folder name in the Inspector, then right-click InitByInspector or call Init at runtime to load the document.
